concept.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity desktop web app screen, 1440x1000 aspect ratio, for Chinese speculative design interactive narrative titled 《这一次，轮椅该听谁的？》. A usable storytelling app, no marketing hero. Warm OFF-WHITE #F4F2EC background, charcoal #202C2B Chinese sans serif typography, forest teal #285C52 accent, thin warm gray lines. Quiet editorial typography, generous space, accessible large text. Header top left title, top right compact text navigation 情境体验 / 分镜 / 研究依据. Thin horizontal progress line with 01 情境 02 选择 03 后果 04 修正. Main two columns: left 56% a large framed soft architectural illustration of an independent older Chinese woman with short gray hair in teal cardigan sitting in a grounded realistic electric wheelchair at the doorway to a community activity room, subtle rim sensors, NO robot face or humanoid torso, natural day light. Small native text caption below image 换了底盘，还是熟悉的路。. Right 44% shows large heading 你熟悉这里。
新的身体还不熟悉。 and compact paragraph 还有 6 分钟，合唱排练就要开始。轮椅在熟悉的门口停下：旧底盘的通行记录，不能确认新底盘也能通过。. Native quotation 我记得这条路，但还不能确认现在的身体能过去。. Button full teal 进入选择 followed by low contrast text 你将扮演使用者林岚。. Bottom fine line footnote 思辨原型 v1 · 情境、时间与结果为设计虚构. No fake metrics, no extra labels, no rounded card grid, no gradients. Text should be correctly spelled. Illustration is fictional, dignified adult who expresses her own choices, NOT helpless. This image is design concept only; real controls will be coded.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a single clean 2x2 four-panel storyboard sheet for a fictional wheelchair robot story, each panel equally sized, separated by thin warm white gutters. Wide overall landscape 3:2. Style elegant natural architectural watercolor with restrained fine ink detail, muted teal, warm limestone, charcoal, soft daylight. Consistent protagonist in every panel: dignified older Chinese woman with short gray hair, teal cardigan, light beige trousers, independently operating a realistic electric wheelchair with small subtle sensors and armrest tablet, no robot face, no humanoid torso, no nurse pushing. Panel1 upper left: in small bright accessible apartment, the woman looks at the newly replaced black chassis below her chair, repair worker kneels beside it with a tool case; a spare old chassis rests nearby, repair event mundane. Panel2 upper right: she stops in front of a narrow door at a community choir room, side view, room beyond contains adults with sheet music; chair stopped, hand resting on joystick, no crash or injury. Panel3 lower left: close view of the woman making a choice on her armrest tablet, thoughtful but determined, doorway in background, screen abstract simple teal choice rows with NO readable text. Panel4 lower right: the following day at same doorway, she taps a small consent prompt on tablet, chair at rest; the door is visibly opened wider by community staff, she remains decision maker. All panels eye-level respectful composition, no infantilization, realistic human anatomy, credible wheelchair mechanics. No written text, captions, logos, watermarks, panel numbers, speech bubbles, fake dimension arrows. This is speculative design fiction not a real study.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one standalone landscape 4:3 high quality narrative illustration for a Chinese speculative design app. An independent older Chinese woman with short silver-gray bob, teal cardigan, light beige trousers, in realistic compact black electric wheelchair with armrest joystick and subtle rim sensors, stops at the doorway to a bright community activity choir room. Viewed rear three-quarter so her composed thoughtful face visible. She is making her own decision, not helpless. Chair is a practical mobility body with no humanoid torso or robot face. A slightly narrow doorway ahead, a few adults holding sheet music inside, limestone walls and plants, warm daylight. Sophisticated architectural watercolor combined with restrained precise fine ink, muted warm stone and forest teal, no loud colors. Composition woman and wheelchair occupy left two-thirds, door opening to right. No text at all on walls bags or screen, no logos, no watermarks, no UI overlay. Palette harmonizes with warm off-white #F4F2EC and dark teal #285C52. This is fictional scenario illustration, not real evidence.

note: 所有人物场景均为设计虚构。实际界面由HTML/CSS/JS重新实现；视觉概念图不当作可点击界面交付。
